newsitem.title: INDIA: India releases 2.25 mln tonnes free sale sugar.
newsitem.headline: India releases 2.25 mln tonnes free sale sugar.

text.p: India's Food Ministry said on Tuesday that it will release 750,000 tonnes of free sale sugar in each of the months of July, August and September, a total of 2.25 million tonnes.
The ministry said in a statement that the release for free sale was in addition to the 369,000 tonnes of levy sugar quota released for each of the months of July, August and September.
The free sale quota along with the levy sugar already released would increase the availability of sugar to 1.119 million tonnes per month, the statement said.

"The free sale quotas are made only for internal consumption and with enough stock of sugar in hand, government would not hesitate in releasing further substantial quantities additionally in case the requirement so dictates," the statement said.
